en-US.title: Hanja · Basic radicals 214
en-US.description:
Learn the 214 Kangxi radicals in numbered order, with Korean meaning-and-reading mnemonics, positional forms and example characters. Distinguish left-side 阝 (阜) from right-side 阝 (邑), and 月 from the positional form of 肉. The learning target remains Korean Hanja; explanations are localized, while Korean readings are preserved.

Sources: Unicode Unihan 17.0.0 (Unicode License v3); libhangul Hanja dictionary (BSD 3-Clause); National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary XML (2026-06-19, CC BY-SA 2.0 KR). Dictionary materials have been adapted into learning cards; stage assignments and representative meanings are editorial choices. English and Japanese compound definitions reuse the dictionary's translations; Chinese definitions are converted to Taiwan Traditional orthography with OpenCC. ja.title: 韓国漢字 · 基本部首214
ja.description:
康熙部首214部を番号順に学びます。韓国語の音訓、位置による字形の変化、代表的な漢字を一緒に確認できます。左側の阝（阜）と右側の阝（邑）、月と肉の変形を区別しましょう。学習対象は韓国漢字です。説明を翻訳しても韓国語の読みは変わりません。

**one**

한 일

Kangxi radical No. 1

下 — below (아래 하)

上 — above (위 상)

### Learning note

A radical is an indexing category used to look up characters in dictionaries. It does not represent every component or explain a character's origin.
